Counsel for Respondent :- A.S.G.I.,Akanksha Gaur,C.S.C.,Pranjal Mehrotra
Hon'ble Siddhartha Varma,J.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, Ms. Akanksha Gaur, learned counsel for the respondent
nos.2, 3 and 4, Sri Pranjal Mehrotra, learned counsel for the respondent no.1 and learned Standing
Counsel for the State.
When the petitioners were not being paid the compensation, they approached this Court by means of Writ C No.22805 of 2022 which was disposed of on 07.09.2022.

entities.text: Murari Lal And 2 Others vs Union Of India And 5 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: We, therefore,
do not find any ground to issue a positive mandamus.

It is, however, provided that the petitioners may file an application before the competent authority in accordance with the provisions of Section 3H of the National Highways Act, 1956 giving details of their right, title and share in the land in question and the description of other heirs/co-owners of the land.

In case such an application is filed within a period of three weeks along with the copy of this order, the competent authority shall be under obligation to make the necessary inquiry and pass an appropriate order in the matter of disbursement of compensation.

It is made clear that independent consideration shall be made by the competent authority and the directions issued therein will not be treated as a ground to release the compensation in favour of the petitioners without completion of the necessary inquiry.
The writ petition is, accordingly, disposed of."
In pursuance thereof, the petitioners filed representation before the competent authority/Additional District Magistrate, Land Acquisition Officer, Firozabad.
This representation came to be rejected on 27.03.2023 on the basis of the fact that review application had been filed before the arbitrator.
After the application was decided on 27.03.2023, the arbitration proceedings before the arbitrator also came to an end on 21.04.2023.

The petitioners have brought to the notice of the respondent no.5,
Competent Authority/ Additional District Magistrate, Land Acquisition Officer, Firozabad that the arbitration proceedings had come to an end on 21.04.2023.
Under such circumstances, the Court is of the view that a fresh decision be taken by respondent no.5 taking into consideration that the arbitration proceedings have come to an end on 21.04.2023.

The competent authority shall now decide the representation of the petitioners dated 12.05.2023, which the petitioners had filed after the rejection of the arbitration proceedings, within a period of one month from the date of production of a certified copy of this order, in accordance with law.
With the direction above, the writ petition is disposed of.

Order Date :- 17.7.2023 A.Kr.
